title: agent-orchestrator guardrail controls registry
description: Schema for guardrails/policy/controls.yaml — the declarative registry of every toggleable control on the guardrail control surface (issue #26 acceptance #3). Every control ships enabled:false by default (flag-gated OFF doctrine, AO-GR-6); flipping a control ON is the deliberate, reviewed act that activates the policies gated behind it. The registry is data — the engine reads it to decide whether a control-gated policy is active.

id.description: Stable slug; policies gate on this id. Never renamed once shipped.

description.description: What enabling this control actually activates.

enabled.description: Default OFF (AO-GR-6). A control that ships ON must document on_since_rationale.

mode.description: Intended decision mode of the control's gates. 'off' requires enabled:false.

implemented_by.description: Repo-relative paths to the policy file(s) this control activates.

on_since_rationale.description: Required when enabled:true — why this control legitimately ships ON.

notes.description: Informational notes for operators (never evaluated by the engine).
